verdict.rationale: Sketch's native .sketch format is a documented, zipped archive of JSON and binary data with a public spec on GitHub. A community user confirms the format is basically zipped JSON that tools and git can work with, and `sketchtool` can export assets from the command line, so design files are readable outside the app. However, nothing shows a bulk export of a whole Workspace (cloud documents, comments, version history, prototypes) or export to vendor-neutral standards, and one user reports being unable to open old files without a license that runs on a newer macOS. Missing for 10: bulk Workspace/account data export, documented export to standard interchange formats (SVG/PDF), export of comments, versions and prototype data, and an off-boarding or data-portability guide.
